content: What's a good exercise for my upper chest?

Incline Barbell Press or Incline Dumbbell Press are your best bets for upper chest development, Alex! 💪 The incline angle (30–45°) shifts the focus to the clavicular head of the pec for that thick upper chest look. Want me to add either of these to today's Push Day workout?
Sounds good, add it to today's workout.
Which one do you want to add — Incline Barbell Press or Incline Dumbbell Press?
